major_issues: Mobile: the primary flow canvas/graph is effectively unreadable at default scale; the zoom/fit controls are too small and not discoverable enough to make the main feature usable.
Mobile: several panels show clipped/overflow risk and cramped content density (chips + long URLs + multi-line descriptions) with insufficient responsive typography/line-height; readability suffers.
Header/top controls: mixed placement and weak hierarchy (status pill + “Run UI review loop” + tabs + zoom controls) creates a crowded, ambiguous primary action area, especially on mobile.
medium_issues: Contrast/readability: secondary text (timestamps, small labels, muted descriptions) is too low-contrast against the dark background; small type is borderline on mobile.
Spacing/padding inconsistencies between cards (some feel airy, others tight); vertical rhythm is uneven, making scanning harder.
Chips/badges wrap unpredictably on mobile (e.g., model/round/capture); wrapping increases height and pushes key content down without adding clarity.
Right column cards on desktop look visually similar in weight; primary vs secondary information is not differentiated enough (same border, same elevation).
Graph container has a lot of unused empty space above the nodes on both desktop and mobile; composition feels top-heavy with a large blank grid region.
minor_issues: Tap targets: small icon buttons (refresh/zoom +/-) appear under 44px on mobile.
Long tokens/labels (host, blocker id, endpoints) need consistent truncation rules; some lines look like they will overflow or force awkward wraps depending on device width.
Some headings are in all-caps/small-caps with low contrast; reduces readability and perceived polish.

recommended_changes.change: Improve mobile usability of the flow canvas: on small widths set the graph container to a fixed aspect/height (e.g., 55–65vh), increase default zoom/scale for readability, and make Fit/Zoom controls larger and sticky within the canvas (min 44px tap targets).

Add robust text overflow handling for long strings (URLs, IDs, hostnames): use `overflow-wrap:anywhere` for paragraphs, and for single-line fields use `text-overflow: ellipsis; overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap;` with max-width constraints; ensure chips don’t blow out card width.

Increase typography legibility on mobile: bump base font-size and line-height (e.g., 15–16px with 1.4–1.6), and raise contrast for secondary text (lighter muted color) to meet readability/contrast expectations.

Clarify top-of-page hierarchy: group the status pill + primary action(s) into a single header row; move secondary controls (tabs/zoom) into the card header of the canvas; avoid having multiple control clusters competing at the top on mobile.

Normalize card spacing and vertical rhythm: standardize card padding (e.g., 16–20px), header spacing, and inter-card gaps; reduce dense sections by adding consistent section dividers and spacing between chip rows and body text.

Differentiate information hierarchy in the right column: increase emphasis for the most important card (e.g., Runtime/alerts) via slightly higher elevation/border brightness, and reduce weight for secondary cards to improve scanability.

Tune the canvas composition: reduce unused empty space above nodes by adjusting internal padding/margins or initial pan position; on desktop consider centering the flow vertically within the viewport section.
If zoom/fit is implemented in JS, add a mobile-first default (auto-fit on load for <=480px, then apply a +10–20% zoom) and persist the last zoom level in localStorage to reduce repeated fiddling.

stop_reason: Not production-worthy yet due to mobile usability: the primary flow visualization is too small to read and the control affordances are too tiny/undiscoverable; additionally, long-text overflow and low-contrast small typography reduce readability and polish.
